allocation.reconciliation_note: Entry slippage of still open positions is unrealized and is excluded from the realized counterfactual; the full-fill figure is reported separately as NOT_VERIFIED_SCOPE_MISMATCH.

counterfactual.reconciliation_note: Entry slippage of still open positions is unrealized and is excluded from the realized counterfactual; the full-fill figure is reported separately as NOT_VERIFIED_SCOPE_MISMATCH.
counterfactual.disclaimer: Hypothetical counterfactual for research calibration only. Commissions and funding held constant. Real-market liquidity friction cannot be eliminated.

contract_fixture_partial_close.description: Documented partially closed position: entry 0.021, realized 0.010, still open 0.011, entry slippage drag 0.021.

allocation.realized_pnl_scope_reason: Partially closed positions are present. virtual_positions.net_pnl is realized-only but carries the entry fee of the full initial quantity and funding accrued on the remaining quantity; the closed-quantity share of those costs is not persisted. The realized-scope Net PnL and the counterfactual stay unavailable (PARTIAL_CLOSE_UNRESOLVED) rather than assuming the whole net_pnl is realized closed-quantity PnL.
allocation.reconciliation_note: Entry slippage of partially closed positions is allocated proportionally to the realized closed volume, but the realized-scope Net PnL is unresolved because net_pnl mixes full-quantity entry fees and open-remainder funding. The counterfactual stays unavailable.

contract_fixture_partial_close.conclusion: The entry drag is split 0.010 realized / 0.011 open. The partial-close realized Net PnL scope is unresolved from persisted data, so the counterfactual stays null; the full-fill figure is classified NOT_VERIFIED_SCOPE_MISMATCH.

limitations: The archive export contains no partially closed position, so the proportional drag allocation is proven by the unit test and by the synthetic contract fixture, not by archive data.

Partially closed positions cannot produce a verified realized-scope Net PnL because the persisted position snapshot does not separate the closed-quantity share of the full-quantity entry fee and open-remainder funding.
Open positions carry an unrealized entry drag that is excluded from the realized counterfactual; their entry fees are reported separately.
Single bounded 24h forward-paper export; not a statistical sample and never a profitability claim.
